decisions.evidence: The pre-reader Definition used undefined supersymmetry/BPS/supercharge terminology in a non-load-bearing aside. The reader replaced it by the precise statement that no additional property follows. The selected-model, collar, all-input isotopy, fusion topology and same-model symmetry requirements are unchanged. Read the full defect supplier and the cited Gaiotto introduction and Carqueville section 2.1; checked all three actual direct consumers and the directed TikZCD. Retained item bytes equal the reader result; amended stale manifest statement and downstream contract excerpts, and completed the HIGH risk review.

The pre-reader construction omitted explicit Hamiltonian endomorphism types and units for all time and matrix data. The reader makes these explicit without changing the counterexample. For every finite input the zero-Hamiltonian product is position-independent, the stated denominator is nonzero, source and target have unequal dimensions, and rank(JS)<=1<2 excludes a two-sided linear inverse. The universal claim is refuted. Retained item bytes equal the reader result; amended its stale interface citation excerpt in the contract.

The pre-reader example left state-space symbols and the transport of a mixed source/target input insufficiently explicit, and compressed the reverse-interface and arbitrary-interface-sequence checks. The reader specifies all types, units and transport and supplies the adjoint crossing identity and all-input inverse-pair argument. Independently checked V-dagger V=I, H_+V=VH_-, both exponential identities, all finite-list products, and both normalized fusion limits with nonzero identity-limit denominator. Continuous endpoint propagators preserve the proof for shrinking collars. Retained item bytes equal the reader result; amended the manifest statement, exact contract derivation excerpts and supplier citation; HIGH risk review complete.

The pre-reader Example used U_g before introducing G and its matrices, and omitted explicit time/operator units. The reader orders definitions before use and specifies the units. Independently checked U_1 squared=I, U_1 X U_1 inverse=-X, density-matrix domain preservation, trace covariance for all finite insertion lists including other defects, isotopy within each ordering chamber, and exact all-correlator group fusion. No statistical or continuum claim is used. Retained item bytes equal the reader result; amended its manifest statement and stale interface citation excerpt; HIGH risk review complete.
